content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lake Charles

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a secondary degree plus documented project-management experience, or a four-year degree with less experience. Review PMI's specific education and hours thresholds on the official PMI website, then contact Granite PM Academy to verify your background meets the credential's entry requirements.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our expert instructors deliver the full PMI-required curriculum in an interactive, real-time format designed to fit working professionals' schedules while building the knowledge you'll need for exam success.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the course, prepare and submit your formal PMI application, which includes verification of your education and project-management experience. Pay the associated examination fee to PMI directly. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the submission process to ensure accuracy.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—including practice tests, study guides, and instructor support—to review PMP domains and refine your test-taking strategy. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE, and sit for the computer-based exam at an approved testing center near Lake Charles.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After you earn your PMP, commit to PMI's three-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved training, conference attendance, volunteer work, or published articles. Renew your credential before expiration to keep it active and protect your professional standing.
